packages.name: xecjk
packages.tlpobj:
name xecjk
category Package
revision 80059
shortdesc Typeset CJK in XeLaTeX
relocated 1
longdesc xeCJK is a package for typesetting documents in Chinese,
longdesc Japanese or Korean with XeLaTeX. It provides CJK-specific
longdesc automatic glue between CJK and non-CJK characters, full control
longdesc over CJK punctuation compression, separate font families for
longdesc CJK and Latin scripts, and a number of fine-grained typographic
longdesc refinements for the CJK script.
depend ctex
depend fontspec
depend l3kernel
depend l3packages
